name: @opencast/sync-worker
description: Self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted OpenCast Cloud Sync server for Cloudflare Workers + D1.
author: Serge Alex Serbinenko

SYNC_TOKEN.description: A long random access token. Generate one in OpenCast → Settings → Cloud Sync, or run `openssl rand -hex 32`. Keep it like a password. This is not your encryption passphrase.

DB.description: Stores encrypted sync records, vault metadata, and device registrations. OpenCast creates its schema on first use.

NOTIFIER.description: A SQLite Durable Object that sends WebSocket change hints to your devices. The app also polls for changes.
